title: SupabaseSignUpRequest
description: Request body Mira sends to Supabase GoTrue's POST /auth/v1/signup. Confirmed from Mira/Services/SupabaseService.swift's signUp(email:password:name:). A 200 response with no access_token means signup succeeded but email confirmation is pending (not an error) — see SupabaseAuthResponse for the success shape, and note the client must treat 'no session in the response' as a distinct, non-error outcome.
